percentile_expression.reported_expression: np.mean([1 for x in null_rates if bigram_rate > x]) / len(null_rates) * 100
percentile_expression.correct_form_for_count: 100 * sum(score < observed for score in null_rates) / len(null_rates)
percentile_expression.finding: The saved 0.1% display is not the empirical percentile: it is fixed at 0.1% whenever at least one null score is below observed.
